report:
Skin, left forearm, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin measuring 0.4 x 0.4 x 0.3 cm. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. The epidermis shows moderate spongiosis with parakeratosis and spongiotic vesicles. The dermis shows a mild superficial perivascular infiltrate of lymphocytes and eosinophils, with papillary dermal oedema. No fungal organisms are identified on PASD stain. The overall features are those of a spongiotic dermatitis with eosinophils. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, left forearm, punch biopsy - SPONGIOTIC DERMATITIS with EOSINOPHILS (please see description)
